'''Rigis Corazon''' purchased [[Gryseium Incorporated]] from founder [[Huegu Eib]]. Corazon attempted to use Gryseium Incorporated to corner the food market on [[Demophon]], but failed due to a lack of a contract with the Demophonian government or the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Sabel Axis Corazon]], his daughter, later took control over the company after Corazon was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by agents of a rival company.
